market.title: Points exchange
market.note: Quotes, the order book and trades are visible to everyone; placing or cancelling an order requires sign-in. All prices are quoted in platform points ($).

market.pairDegenerate: That pair is invalid and was skipped: the platform pricing currency cannot be paired with itself.
market.bookNote: The order book is public market data and updates as orders are placed.
market.mineNote: Your open orders appear here; cancelling returns only the funds still frozen for the unfilled part, and fees are not refunded.
market.placeNote: Placing an order freezes funds: a buy order freezes price x amount in $, a sell order freezes that amount of the currency you are selling.
market.baseNote: Enter the currency id you want to trade (cannot be the platform pricing unit $)

ledger.balanceNote: The balance shown reflects the assets in your platform account.
